body.statement: Using the vanishing-penalty active-cone handle, characterize the local asymptotic minimax risk and limit experiment for \(h_s(u)\) at every skeleton law where the reduced dual program has multiple optimal vertices, and construct one data-driven estimator and confidence procedure that attains the resulting face-by-face frontier without knowing the active cone.
body.justification: The exact behavior at facet switches is the first-class open content left after finite-sample coverage and regular-face optimality.
body.gap: Levis et al. use margins or smoothing and Gafarov uses generic quadratic regularization; neither supplies the exact target-IV local minimax phase diagram.
body.consumer: An attaining procedure would replace conservative whole-set projection by shorter calibrated intervals whenever the observed skeleton is near, but not exactly on, a dual tie.
